bull.b: Interim tagmokitug results provide evidence of activity in a difficult oncology setting, including previously treated patients. If confirmed in planned studies, this differentiated pipeline could expand Coherus beyond biosimilars and create a broader, potentially durable oncology franchise.

The planned rightsizing directly lowers the recurring cost base while preserving substantially all of the commercial organization. Faster operating-expense reduction should reduce the revenue needed for core-cost coverage and improve the path toward commercial breakeven.

A debt-free TTM balance sheet and positive equity represent a meaningful structural improvement from prior periods with negative equity. This cleaner capital structure can reduce leverage pressure and give management more flexibility to prioritize products and development spending.

bear.b: Cash consumption remains exceptionally high relative to the current revenue base, creating a persistent need for profitability improvement or external financing. Sustained burn can constrain development investment, weaken negotiating leverage, and increase funding risk over the coming quarters.

The sharply smaller revenue base indicates that existing commercial scale is not yet supporting the operating structure. Deeply negative profitability means gross profit is overwhelmed by expenses or charges, limiting internal funding capacity and making a durable earnings recovery uncertain.

Low current market share leaves substantial commercial conversion work before LOQTORZI can support the business at scale. Continued use of chemotherapy alone and off-label immunotherapies creates durable adoption barriers, while limited share increases dependence on successful payer and physician expansion.
